Definition: something protracted or flattened out, i.e. a platter
BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsêlâchâh, meaning a platter. It appears once, in 2 Chronicles 35:13.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsêlâchâh matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
